acquisition.note: All individual CSV payloads were GET-fetched without authentication, parsed in memory and not saved to the workspace.

rights.repository_license: MIT LICENSE file is present, but its text licenses software and associated documentation; no explicit dataset-specific license or per-file permission is provided in the data README. Corpus includes third-party AWS, ad-exchange, traffic, taxi, and Twitter data. Do not infer permission for all data files from the repository code license.
rights.disposition: cross out all 58 under strict open-reuse criterion until every source-file rights chain is established; public downloadability does not supply rights.

difficulty.reason: No blanket dataset license or per-file rights established. The labels provide anomaly timestamps; fixed windows fit the MLP structurally, but held-out non-saturation and event quality are not empirically established. Six of 58 files have zero anomaly timestamps and are not supervised event tasks under these labels.
